metadata.title: Region Coloring of Spatial Graphs using Knot-theoretic Ternary Quasigroups
metadata.abstract: We construct coloring conditions around vertices for region colorings of unoriented spatial graph diagrams by knot-theoretic ternary quasigroups. These conditions require cyclic products of left and right operators around each vertex to be the identity. We prove that the resulting coloring sets are preserved under the generalized Reidemeister moves and relate our construction to the palette framework. We show that the vertex coloring conditions are automatic for Dehn tribrackets and determine the associated palettes for unoriented Alexander tribrackets. We also introduce an additional restriction on vertex colorings that is preserved under the fifth Reidemeister move for every unoriented knot-theoretic ternary quasigroup. This restriction gives rise to further coloring invariants for Dehn tribrackets and unoriented Alexander tribrackets.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 空间图区域着色的顶点条件
analysis.workSummary: 用结理论三元拟群给无向空间图着色，要求绕每个顶点的左右算子循环乘积为恒等。作者证明所得着色集合在广义 Reidemeister 移动下保持。
analysis.breakthrough: 把条件联系到 palette 框架，证明 Dehn tribracket 自动满足顶点约束，并确定无向 Alexander tribracket 的 palette。额外限制在任意无向结理论三元拟群下保持第五种移动，并对这两类 tribracket 给进一步着色不变量。
analysis.limitations: 额外限制对一般三元拟群的明示结论只涉及第五种移动，完整进一步不变量的结论点名 Dehn 和无向 Alexander 两类。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露用 Microsoft Copilot 和 Google Gemini 编辑英文、调整 LaTeX 格式及部分数学论证的呈现，并编写和修改例4.10计算搜索所用的程序。作者独立核查数学陈述、证明和代码。用途记为写作和计算代码。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.17379v1 · PDF 第25页 Tool Use
